title: Make the selected signal registry callback readable to the unsafe exposure auditor
delta: Single four-byte insertion (dyn + space) in the upstream callback type alias. The project uses a pinned compiler supporting explicit trait objects; every other upstream implementation byte and original attribution remain unchanged.
accept: Execute the original crate tests and show Geiger measures its previously unreadable source. The root manifest/lock join must be committed by their owner before normal workspace use.
